title: urachne
intro: Urachne, commonly known as the prickly-pear vine, is a plant species from the genus Urachne. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions. The therapeutic actions of Urachne include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Urachne plant contribute to its health benefits, providing protection against oxidative stress, inflammation, and microbial infections.
